newsitem.title: SRI LANKA: PRESS DIGEST - Sri Lanka Newspapers - January 23.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - Sri Lanka Newspapers - January 23.

text.p: These are the leading stories in the Sri Lankan press on Thursday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
Police release pictures of two Tamil Tiger rebel suicide bombers planning to assassinate VIPs in Colombo.
Police seize big stock of heroin from boat in Negombo lagoon.
Police find stock of 12.7 mm bullets and explosives buried in garden of house at Piliyandala, in Colombo suburb.
Kfir fighter jet crashed into Negombo lagoon after flight controls failed, pilot who ejected says.
Indian External Affair Inder Kumar Gujral says solution to Sri Lanka's ethnic conflict will be of advantage to India as well but New delhi will not interfere in Sri Lanka's internal affairs.
